name: Contact form
purpose: The site's only real form — a vertically-centered 480px column of four fields and a submit. It is the entire content of /contact.
constraintNote: mustBeFirst AND mustBeLastContentSection simultaneously, because /contact is the one route whose body is a single section. This is real, not a contradiction.
behaviorNote: onSubmit calls preventDefault and nothing else. The submit button is disabled until all four fields are non-empty. No data leaves the page. Do NOT wire a generated version to a real endpoint.
